newsitem.title: USA: Transtech may sell assets over tax matter.
newsitem.headline: Transtech may sell assets over tax matter.

text.p: Transtech Industries Inc said on Thursday that it is evaluating its strategic alternatives, including the sale of assets, to meet projected tax and environmental obligations, as well as ongoing litigation expenses.

The company said it faces uncertainties stemming from an audit of its federal income tax returns and ongoing environmental remediation activities at sites previously used by the company's subsidiaries.
Transtech said it continues to contest certain deficiencies asserted in the audit in Tax Court, including the use of operating loss and tax credit carry-forwards to offset income.
